en: The postcard consists of two sides. The front side shows a black and white photograph of a park or estate with a central building, some trees, and a few people standing at the entrance. The text 'Sundsvall / Tivoli' is printed in the bottom left corner of the image, with handwritten Swedish text below it. The reverse side is addressed in elegant cursive handwriting to 'Fru Maria Wemerström' in 'Maluberget', and includes printed Swedish postal instructions, a Swedish stamp with the denomination 5 öre, and a postmark.
